prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production avatar FRAME for Glyph season ZÊNITE I. ONE isolated circular frame, front orthographic, true transparent RGBA background AND completely transparent circular central photo opening. Reference1 existing Glyph celestial frame is construction/style reference, reference2 ivory solar outfit is PALETTE and motif reference. Do not reproduce stars/galaxy from old frame.
DESIGN: premium ivory enamel and warm brushed SOLAR GOLD ring with bronze recessed seams. Four or eight broad radial ribs, bold sun emblem at twelve o'clock, short tasteful gold rays staying close to ring. Strong circular silhouette, symmetrical, readable when displayed at 48 pixels. Broad clear material planes, few large ornaments, NOT fine filigree. Ivory #EAE2CF, pale gold #C4A15A, small bronze #796044; bright but not glowing yellow. Same family as the solar breastplate. No crown, no text, no letters/numerals, no portrait, no scenery, no sparkles or particle aura.
GEOMETRY: square 1024x1024 composition. Exact circle center (512,512); central transparent hole diameter 650 pixels, perfectly round, continuous clean inner edge. Outer ring diameter about 900px; sun ornament can reach y35 but don't touch canvas edges. Minimum outer margin30px. Ring robust, about100px thick; ornaments mainly outward, never cover the photo hole. Full ring visible, no perspective, no ellipse, no shadows outside silhouette, no opaque black/gray/white center. Isolated crafted artifact, semi-realistic 3D game-item rendering, soft highlight from upper left.

Production profile NAMEPLATE BANNER for Glyph season ZÊNITE I. Image1 is the matching NEW solar frame: inherit ivory enamel, brushed gold, bronze recesses and sun emblem. Image2 existing Aurora nameplate is SHAPE, aspect ratio and typography reference only, do not copy its green palette or wording.
ONE slender horizontal solid premium nameplate, front orthographic, total art ratio 6:1, e.g. 1200 pixels wide by200 tall, centered on a WIDE landscape transparent RGBA canvas. No other objects. Crop-efficient long silhouette, only small transparent safety margin; if canvas is taller leave unused area fully transparent. DO NOT squash words. Left and right tapered ends, thin layered bronze/gold rim, ivory enamel central face. Small sun medallions integrated at far left and right ends, do not protrude vertically or compete with letters. Broad uninterrupted text field. Polished crafted 3D fantasy UI artifact, matching image1 materials, restrained details. NO giant crest on top, no scroll ribbon, no illustration scene.
EXACT TEXT centered on one line: "ZÊNITE I". Portuguese circumflex above Ê MUST be present and clear. Large elegant engraved Roman serif capitals in dark bronze with narrow gold highlights for strong readability against ivory. Letter height ~50% of plaque height, generous spacing, readable when banner is displayed at 52px tall. No other text, no season word, no subtitle. Actual alpha transparency around the plate, no checkerboard, no opaque background, no cast shadow outside silhouette.

Glyph ZÊNITE I season INSIGNIA, one solid collectible medal emblem, NOT an avatar frame. Reference1 the new Zênite ring provides approved palette and sun motif. Reference2 existing Genesis insignia provides 3D crafted standalone badge style and visual weight only. Do not copy Genesis purple or swirl.
Design a bold eight-rayed SOLAR MEDALLION with faceted ivory enamel central diamond holding a small raised golden sun disk. Thick brushed warm gold bevels, bronze recesses, broad ivory inlays. Clear compact radial silhouette, subtly taller than wide, no tiny filigree. Sun disk is opaque crafted metal, no hollow portrait opening. Distinct, legible at 40px and satisfying at 200px. Ivory #EAE2CF, gold #C4A15A, small bronze #796044, no gems of other colors. Mythic reward premium but restrained, physical metal/enamel object, softly illuminated upper left. True transparent RGBA outside silhouette and natural spaces between rays. Square canvas with 8% margin on all sides. Frontal orthographic, centered, no tilt/perspective. No text, no letters or numbers, no ribbon, no crown, no surrounding halo, no background or ground shadow. Just the medallion.

Production circular avatar FRAME for Glyph ECLIPSE I. Reference1 existing Aurora frame is geometry/construction reference only. Reference2 Eclipse outfit supplies obsidian, aged silver and dark wine palette. One perfectly round front orthographic crafted ring with TRUE TRANSPARENT central photo hole and outer background.
Design: OBSIDIAN matte enamel ring inset with broad dark burgundy/wine segments, edged in aged SILVER. Layered offset silver arcs suggest overlapping celestial disks, balanced circular silhouette. At twelve o'clock a compact solid obsidian disk partly covered by a bright silver crescent — an eclipse brooch. A small matching crescent clasp at bottom, few broad silver side bands. No spikes, no stars/galaxy, no purple glow, no gold, no red danger glow. Palette obsidian #202026, aged silver #A7A5AD, wine #612D42, charcoal #37353E. Restrained premium gothic duelist craft, readable at48px with broad shapes, not tangled filigree. Match garment materials; not simply recolored jade frame.
Square canvas, circle center exactly center; central alpha hole diameter64% of canvas width, clean circular inner edge, no intruding crest/ornaments. Outer silhouette fits within94% of canvas with safe margins; ring symmetric, no ellipse/perspective. Keep photo center fully empty transparent, no backing, no fake black center. No text, portrait, background, glow particles or cast shadow. 3D game artifact, softly lit from upper left, real alpha.

Glyph ECLIPSE I production profile NAMEPLATE BANNER. Reference1 new matching Eclipse frame gives exact dark wine/obsidian/aged silver materials and crescent eclipse motif. Reference2 old Aurora nameplate gives slender long shape and serif typography only.

Deep wine #612D42, nearblack #202026, worn silver #A7A5AD, no gold, no purple stars. Physical premium crafted fantasy UI.
EXACT TEXT "ECLIPSE I" on one line, large engraved silver Roman serif capitals, high contrast and readable at52px tall, letter height ~50% of plaque. Do not use any other words or duplicate letters. Actual transparency all around the item, small safe margins.

Glyph ECLIPSE I season INSIGNIA. ONE solid wearable collectible badge, NOT an avatar border; no central photo hole. Image1 new Eclipse frame is palette/motif reference, image2 Genesis badge is standalone item visual-weight reference.
Bold dark OBSIDIAN disk embraced by two offset broad aged SILVER crescents, an asymmetrical eclipse emblem with balanced silhouette. No gold, purple, red glow, text or numeral.
Front orthographic, centered on square transparent RGBA canvas with8% empty margin. Alpha only outside artifact and natural open gaps, no shadow outside, no backdrop, no ribbons, no portrait, no particles, no lighting aura. Single emblem.

Safe strong protective identity, polished medieval sentinel craft with modern clarity. NO ice, frost, crystals, gold, purple, crescent, solar rays or fur. Glyph ÉGIDE I season INSIGNIA: one solid standalone SHIELD MEDAL, not an avatar frame. Reference1 new navy/steel frame gives materials and heraldic shield motif. Reference2 Genesis insignia gives crafted game item quality only.
